title: 2007 AMC 12A Problem 1
statement: One ticket to a show costs \(\$20\) at full price. Susan buys \(4\) tickets using a coupon that gives her a \(25\%\) discount. Pam buys \(5\) tickets using a coupon that gives her a \(30\%\) discount. How many more dollars does Pam pay than Susan?

solutions.text:
Susan pays \((4)(0.75)(20)=60\) dollars.

Pam pays \((5)(0.70)(20)=70\) dollars.

So Pam pays \(70-60=10\) more dollars than Susan.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: A \(25\%\) discount means paying \(75\%\) of full price, and a \(30\%\) discount means paying \(70\%\)
